[[Nehdukah]] is a [[pet tamer]] in [[Nightfall]], he explains in his dialogue how he saw the [[Black Moa]] in [[Cantha]] but none believe him. He then gives you a quest in which you have to aid him in charming an [[Impressive Warthog]].

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue needed}}

:'''As a non-Nightfall character or before starting Hog Hunt:''' ''"I'm a handler and trainer of animals. You name a beast and I'll bet I've tamed it. I'm always on the hunt for new and exotic animals for my collection."''
:'''As a Nightfall character after completing Hog Hunt:''' ''"Thanks for keeping my warthog secret. Now these guys finally accept me as a beast master!"''
::'''"What do you do with the animals you collect?"'''
::''"I'm a simple soul, happiest when I can feel the earth under my feet and the sun warming my skin. Training and earning the trust of beasts both great and small brings me more joy than all the riches in Vabbi could provide. Rest assured that each creature under my care will either remain in my collection as a trusted companion or be gifted to one with a similar interest."''
:::'''"I'd like to think it over some more."'''
::'''"{{x}}No, I don't. Good luck with your hunting."''' (Leave)

== Notes ==

* If you bring a [[Black Moa]] to him after completing [[Hog Hunt]], both he and the two who tease him will run in fear.
* His personal story refers to [[Zho]] (from [[Factions]] and [[Eye of the North]]); she is a [[henchman]] who has a Black Moa named [[Onyx]].

{{Anomaly| When Nehdukah is a tamer the decline option starts with: "No, I don't" even though he is not asking a question.}}
